info.title: Identity Graph Provisioning (IGL Runtime)
info.description: Creates Identity Graphs for companies (BOUNDARY) and individuals (FOOTPRINT). The service resolves attributes from a description, records the graph in a hash-chained journal, generates an IGL (Identity Governed Logic) program, and runs it with governed model output. The response includes the program, statement results, journal status, footprint digest, and receipt verification.

get.summary: Check that the provisioning service and model are ready

post.summary: Provision an Identity Graph from a natural-language description of a company or individual
post.description: Resolves attributes, records the graph in a hash-chained journal, generates an IGL program, and runs it with governed model output. Repeated requests reuse the existing journal. For an individual, one example action is observed but not granted. IGL rejects it with IGL_FOOTPRINT_DENIED before generating model output.

description.description: For example, 'Example Energy, LLC is a Texas oil and gas operator' or 'Jordan Avery is a DFIR coordinator in Houston, Texas'

kind.description: Optional. Use BOUNDARY for a company or FOOTPRINT for an individual. Omit to choose automatically.

auto.description: When true, creates a sample graph without a description.

200.description: Provisioned (boot=seed) or replayed (boot=replay) Identity Graph with generated IGL program source, execution results, journal chain head, footprint digest, and receipt verification

get.summary: List every provisioned Identity Graph, newest first

200.description: Array of provisioned graph runtime artifacts

get.summary: Get one provisioned Identity Graph by slug

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Kebab-case slug of the graph, e.g. example-energy-llc
